senses.gloss: m. (Pers. hemyân, Fl. in Levy Targ. Dict. s. v. הֶמְיָנָא) belt, girdle.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 5:3">Succ. V, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Sukkah 51a:16">51ᵃ</cite>) <he>ומהֶמְיָינֵיהֶן היו מפקיעין</he> ed. Y. a. Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) out of their (old) belts they made wicks.
